name: MxChat – AI Chatbot for WordPress
author: mxchat

sections.description:
Documentation | MxChat Pro

Product Demo Videos:

  • MxChat Forms Add-On – Effortlessly create forms to capture leads, support tickets, and more with MxChat Forms!
  • MxChat Intent Tester Add-On – Visualize how your chatbot’s intents perform against user queries and fine-tune its accuracy.
  • WooCommerce Add-On – Display product cards, recommend items, guide users to checkout, and supercharge your store.
  • Chat with PDF & Word – Let users upload and interact with PDFs and Word docs right from your website’s frontend.
  • Optimize with MxChat Agents

Explore all product videos on YouTube

MxChat is a powerful, customizable AI chatbot plugin for WordPress. Seamlessly integrating OpenAI’s GPT, Anthropic’s Claude, and xAI’s Grok-Beta, it enables intelligent, real-time interactions to boost engagement and support.

With advanced Pro features like Live Agent Transfer via Slack, PDF content processing in-chat, WooCommerce integration, lead capture via Loops, and a robust intent recognition system, MxChat excels in making your chatbot more interactive and useful.

The WooCommerce integration enhances the shopping experience by allowing your chatbot to recommend products, display product cards with images, prices, and descriptions, and seamlessly add items to the cart. It can also guide users to the checkout page, streamlining the purchasing process for your customers.

Additional features include email capture, Brave web and image search, and DALL-E image generation, ensuring dynamic and engaging user interactions.

Pro users now get access to MxChat AI Agents – a revolutionary way to test and deploy your MxChat chatbot. These agents allow you to simulate real-world scenarios, refine chatbot performance, and ensure your AI assistant aligns perfectly with your needs.

Additionally, our AI Agents can now analyze your website to help you build intents more effectively, streamlining the setup process for your chatbot. We’ve also introduced an SEO Analyzer Agent, which evaluates your website’s SEO performance and sends you a detailed analysis via email, helping you improve your site’s visibility and performance.

MxChat supports custom knowledge integration via manual input, URLs, PDF uploads, or sitemaps, ensuring highly relevant, context-aware responses. Its theme customization aligns the chatbot with your branding, while GDPR compliance and support for multiple language models like Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Grok-Beta expand its versatility.

Perfect for product catalogs, manuals, or FAQs, MxChat empowers businesses with smarter AI-powered conversations. Whether you’re enhancing customer support or driving sales, MxChat is a flexible and reliable solution.

New in Version 2.0.9:

  • Revamped UI – Completely redesigned the main settings page with a modern interface that matches the rest of the plugin. Enjoy a consistent, intuitive experience with our gradient header design and card-based layout throughout the entire plugin.
  • Real-time Processing Updates – Sitemap and PDF processing now display progress in real-time, eliminating the need to refresh the page. Watch as your knowledge base grows with live progress indicators.
  • Renamed: MxChat Similarity Tester – The former “MxChat Intent Tester” add-on has been renamed to “MxChat Similarity Tester” to better reflect its functionality in testing and fine-tuning knowledge base similarity matching.
  • Bug Fixes & Improvements – Various under-the-hood improvements for a more stable and consistent user experience.

New in Version 2.0.7:

  • Perplexity Integration Add-On – Introducing a new add-on that integrates Perplexity for web search capabilities. Seamlessly woven into the intent management system, users can now search the web directly through mxChat. Enable or disable web search with a simple toggle via the Perplexity icon in the toolbar.
  • Sonnet 3.7 Support – Added access to Anthropic’s latest and most advanced model, Claude Sonnet 3.7, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to your chatbot interactions.
  • Bug Fixes & Improvements – Resolved title formatting issues in chatbot responses with title tags. Fine-tuned the knowledge database similarity matching range, now adjusted to a tighter 20 for more precise results.

Expanding the MxChat Add-On Ecosystem

  • Introducing the MxChat Add-Ons Platform – Extend MxChat’s capabilities with powerful add-ons, giving users the flexibility to enhance their chatbot experience with specialized features.
  • Pinecone Integration (Free for All Users) – Easily integrate Pinecone into MxChat to manage your vector database seamlessly. This add-on is available to all users at no cost, enabling AI-driven data organization and retrieval.
  • MxChat Forms (Pro Only) – Enable chatbot-triggered form collection directly within MxChat. Seamlessly create, manage, and integrate forms with automated intent handling and real-time display in chat—exclusive to Pro users.
  • Theme Customization with Live Preview (Pro Only) – Unlock full theme customization with a real-time preview feature. Adjust colors, layouts, and styles dynamically, ensuring a tailored chat experience exclusive to Pro users.
  • Chat Moderation (Pro Only) – Maintain a secure and controlled chat environment with advanced moderation tools. Effortlessly ban users by email or IP, keeping unwanted interactions at bay—available only for Pro users.
  • MxChat WooCommerce (Pro Only) – Enhance your WooCommerce store with AI-powered chat interactions. This add-on enables intelligent product recommendations, order history retrieval, cart management, and seamless checkout assistance—fully integrated with MxChat’s intent system.
  • MxChat Intent Tester (Pro Only) – Optimize your chatbot’s intent recognition with the MxChat Intent Tester. Test user queries against defined intents, view similarity scores, and fine-tune thresholds to ensure accurate responses. Perfect for admins looking to enhance chatbot performance with precision!

The MxChat add-on ecosystem is built to provide flexibility, ensuring users can customize and scale their chatbot experience with the tools that best suit their needs. More add-ons coming soon!

Advanced Intent Recognition

MxChat powers its conversations with a smart and robust intent recognition system that feels almost magical. By using something called vector embedding—a fancy way of understanding the meaning behind words—it listens to what users say and figures out exactly what they need, even if they phrase it in their own unique way. Imagine it like a super-intuitive friend who knows what you mean without you having to spell it out! This clever system matches user questions or requests to specific actions, making the chatbot feel lively and helpful. For example, it can instantly capture email addresses for your mailing list with the Loops Email Capture feature, or pull up real-time answers from the web using Brave Web Search. For those with the Pro version, it can even dig into PDF documents to answer questions or show off WooCommerce product cards with an easy add-to-cart option—turning casual chats into smooth, action-packed experiences that anyone can enjoy.

Available AI Models:

MxChat offers a variety of powerful AI models from OpenAI, X.AI, and Claude (Anthropic). Each model is designed for specific use cases, allowing you to tailor your chatbot’s performance to your needs.

  • OpenAI Models:

    • GPT-4o (Recommended): OpenAI’s flagship model for complex and multi-step tasks. Ideal for businesses needing a high level of AI intelligence.
    • GPT-4o-mini: A smaller, lightweight version of GPT-4o, offering a balance between speed and intelligence for simpler tasks.
    • GPT-4-turbo: The advanced high-intelligence model for demanding tasks requiring deep reasoning.
    • GPT-4: The previous generation of high-performance models designed for complex reasoning and creative responses.
    • GPT-3.5-turbo: A fast and cost-effective model for simple tasks and rapid responses.

  • X.AI Models (Pro Feature):

    • grok-beta & grok-2: A cutting-edge model by X.AI, designed for natural, human-like conversations. It offers advanced language comprehension for personalized and context-aware responses. Ideal for users exploring new AI technology.

  • Claude (Anthropic) Models (Pro Feature):

    • Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Most Intelligent): A top-tier model for highly intelligent conversations, capable of handling complex queries with in-depth understanding.
    • Claude 3 Opus (Highly Complex Tasks): Designed for managing intricate tasks and providing detailed responses.
    • Claude 3 Sonnet (Balanced): A well-rounded model offering a blend of speed and intelligence, ideal for most use cases.
    • Claude 3 Haiku (Fastest): Optimized for speed while maintaining accuracy, perfect for quick and responsive interactions.

  • DeepSeek Models:

    • DeepSeek V3: The latest model from DeepSeek, designed for advanced natural language understanding and enhanced conversational capabilities. Ideal for businesses seeking state-of-the-art AI performance.

These models offer flexibility and performance for a wide range of applications, ensuring that MxChat can handle everything from simple customer support queries to advanced, real-time interactions.

For more demos and tutorials, visit the MxChat YouTube channel.

Use of Third-Party Services:

This plugin requires an active connection to the OpenAI API or X.AI API to generate AI-driven responses. By using this plugin, you consent to sending data to OpenAI’s and/or X.AI’s servers, which may include user queries and other relevant information.

  • Service Providers:
    • OpenAI
    • X.AI
  • Terms of Use:
    • OpenAI API Terms
    • X.AI API Terms
  • Privacy Policies:
    • OpenAI Privacy Policy
    • X.AI Privacy Policy

Please ensure compliance with OpenAI’s & X.AI terms and any applicable data privacy laws.

License & Warranty

This plugin is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free Software Foundation; either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version.

This plugin is distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the GNU General Public License for more details.

Credits

This plugin incorporates the following third-party library:

  • Smalot PDF Parser: Used for parsing and extracting text from PDF files. This library is developed by Smalot and distributed under the MIT License. For more details, visit the Smalot PDF Parser GitHub repository.

This plugin was developed by MxChat.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mxchat folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘MxChat’ settings page to configure your OpenAI API key and other settings.
sections.faq:
How do I obtain an API key for OpenAI?

You can obtain an API key by signing up on the OpenAI website. Once you have the API key, enter it in the plugin settings to start using the AI chatbot.

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

Yes, the Pro version offers extensive theme customization options, including the ability to change the chatbot’s colors, fonts, and background to match your website’s design.

How do I add the chatbot to my site?

You can add the chatbot to your site using the [mxchat_chatbot floating="yes"] or [mxchat_chatbot floating="no"] shortcode. Additionally, you can automatically append the chatbot to your site’s body element from the settings page.

How does the knowledge submission feature work?

You can submit custom content to the knowledge base from the ‘Knowledge’ submenu. This content is processed using vector embeddings, allowing the AI chatbot to provide more accurate and contextually relevant responses.

What is the sitemap submission feature?

The sitemap submission feature allows you to submit a sitemap URL. The plugin will fetch, extract, and add content from the URLs listed in the sitemap to the chatbot’s knowledge base, enhancing the AI’s ability to provide precise and contextually relevant answers.

Imagine it like a super-intuitive friend who knows what you mean without you having to spell it out! This clever system matches user questions or requests to specific actions, making the chatbot feel lively and helpful. For example, it can instantly capture email addresses for your mailing list with the Loops Email Capture feature, or pull up real-time answers from the web using Brave Web Search. For those with the Pro version, it can even dig into PDF documents to answer questions or show off WooCommerce product cards with an easy add-to-cart option—turning casual chats into smooth, action-packed experiences that anyone can enjoy.

Available AI Models:

MxChat offers a variety of powerful AI models from OpenAI, X.AI, and Claude (Anthropic). Each model is designed for specific use cases, allowing you to tailor your chatbot’s performance to your needs.

  • OpenAI Models:

    • GPT-4o (Recommended): OpenAI’s flagship model for complex and multi-step tasks. Ideal for businesses needing a high level of AI intelligence.
    • GPT-4o-mini: A smaller, lightweight version of GPT-4o, offering a balance between speed and intelligence for simpler tasks.
    • GPT-4-turbo: The advanced high-intelligence model for demanding tasks requiring deep reasoning.
    • GPT-4: The previous generation of high-performance models designed for complex reasoning and creative responses.
    • GPT-3.5-turbo: A fast and cost-effective model for simple tasks and rapid responses.

  • X.AI Models (Pro Feature):

    • grok-beta & grok-2: A cutting-edge model by X.AI, designed for natural, human-like conversations. It offers advanced language comprehension for personalized and context-aware responses. Ideal for users exploring new AI technology.

  • Claude (Anthropic) Models (Pro Feature):

    • Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Most Intelligent): A top-tier model for highly intelligent conversations, capable of handling complex queries with in-depth understanding.
    • Claude 3 Opus (Highly Complex Tasks): Designed for managing intricate tasks and providing detailed responses.
    • Claude 3 Sonnet (Balanced): A well-rounded model offering a blend of speed and intelligence, ideal for most use cases.
    • Claude 3 Haiku (Fastest): Optimized for speed while maintaining accuracy, perfect for quick and responsive interactions.

  • DeepSeek Models:

    • DeepSeek V3: The latest model from DeepSeek, designed for advanced natural language understanding and enhanced conversational capabilities. Ideal for businesses seeking state-of-the-art AI performance.

These models offer flexibility and performance for a wide range of applications, ensuring that MxChat can handle everything from simple customer support queries to advanced, real-time interactions.

For more demos and tutorials, visit the MxChat YouTube channel.
